params.prompt: A Hungarian man in his fifties talking warmly and directly to one person he likes, as if recording a personal video message on his phone for a friend. Relaxed, close, intimate, a slight smile in the voice. Natural everyday speech rhythm: the words flow into each other, no gaps between words, no lecturing, no presentation cadence, no stage voice. Same voice as the reference audio. He says exactly this in Hungarian and nothing else: Ezért írtam meg a második kötetet. Onnan indulunk, ahol elakadtál.
